components.css: :host{--ground:#05070a;--ground-2:#0b1016;--ink:#e9eef2;--ink-2:#b8c2cc;--meta:#8b96a2;--line:#1c2630;--line-2:#2b3947;--usual:#d55e00;--usual-ink:#f0894a;--honest:#0072b2;--honest-ink:#56b4e9;--display:'Barlow Semi Condensed','Barlow',sans-serif;--body:'Barlow',system-ui,sans-serif}.ds-switch{display:inline-flex;border:1px solid var(--line-2);border-radius:2px;background:var(--ground)}.ds-switch button{font:600 15px/1 var(--display);letter-spacing:.04em;text-transform:uppercase;padding:14px 20px;color:var(--meta);background:transparent;border:0;cursor:pointer;transition:background-color .15s,color .15s}.ds-switch button+button{border-left:1px solid var(--line-2)}.ds-switch button:hover{color:var(--ink)}.ds-switch button:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--honest-ink);outline-offset:3px}.ds-switch button.on.u{background:var(--usual);color:var(--ground)}.ds-switch button.on.h{background:var(--honest);color:#fff}

narrative.overview:
Every section is a satellite plate in the manner of NASA Earth Observatory features: a near-black ground, the data as the only imagery, and a caption that tells you whether to believe it. The page is one long column of plates separated by hairlines, with a thin running head. Captions sit on hairline rules, never in boxes. Numbers are set inline inside sentences, in the display face, coloured by which test produced them.

The system refuses the climate dashboard: no sidebar, no KPI tiles, no card grid. Depth comes from tone, not shadow. Colour is semantic before it is anything else: orange means the usual test, blue means the honest test, and almost everything else is ink on night.
keyCharacteristics: Near-black ground (#05070a), cool off-white ink, slate metadata.
Condensed display caps for labels and controls; Barlow for reading.
One colour pair, two meanings, never decoration.
Hairline rules (1px) carry structure; 2px corners at most.
The globe is the hero; its Usual/Honest fade is the signature.

rules.name: The Two Meanings Rule
rules.body: Orange is the usual test and blue is the honest test, everywhere, including charts and maps. Never use either as an accent, a brand colour, a category hue or a direction (rising/falling).

rules.name: The Text-Tone Rule
rules.body: On night, set orange and blue text in the text tones (#f0894a, #56b4e9); the fill tones are for areas, rules and marks. The active Usual switch takes Night Ground text, because white on orange is 3.9:1.

rules.name: The Inline Figure Rule
rules.body: A headline number lives inside its sentence, set in the display face at 1.5-1.9em, coloured by its test. It is never lifted into a tile or a big-number block.

rules.name: The Plain Title Rule
rules.body: Plate titles start the plate. No label, plate number or category line sits above a heading.

rules.name: The No-Lift Rule
rules.body: Nothing floats. A new element separates with a hairline or a step of tone, never a shadow.

dos: **Do** colour a number, rule, cell or switch only by the test that produced it: orange #d55e00 / #f0894a for usual, blue #0072b2 / #56b4e9 for honest.
**Do** set key figures inline in the sentence, in the display face at 1.5-1.9em.
**Do** separate with 1px hairlines and a step of tone; keep corners at 2px or square.
**Do** put captions and credits on a hairline rule in slate, 13-14px.
**Do** open a new plate with a plain headline, then a lead at most 66ch wide.
**Do** give every motion a reduced-motion path and every control a visible Honest Blue focus ring.
**Do** keep fonts self-hosted and data local so the plate works offline.
donts: **Don't** use orange or blue as an accent, category colour, brand colour or rising/falling scale.
**Don't** build KPI tiles, big-number cards, a sidebar or a dashboard card grid.
**Don't** put a label, plate number or category line above a heading.
**Don't** use coloured side borders, gradient text, shadows, or emoji and unicode glyphs as icons.
**Don't** box a caption; a warning callout takes a thin full border and tint, never a thick stripe.
**Don't** put white text on the orange fill.
